dedupe_keys.name: nhs estates returns information collection eric england

description: The Estates Returns Information Collection is the main central collection of estates and facilities data from the NHS in England, collected and published by NHS Digital on behalf of the Department of Health, with data from 1999/2000 onwards. Submitting an estates return is compulsory for NHS trusts, and the data support analysis of estates and facilities services; they are published as reported by the organisations, without amendment. Two related datasets are listed: site-level data and trust-level data, which is a separate collection, not a sum of sites, so both are needed for a complete picture. Coverage: NHS trusts and their sites in England. Access: annual publications from NHS Digital and records on data.gov.uk, last modified July 2026. Licence: UK Open Government Licence; free. Caveats: accuracy and completeness are the responsibility of the reporting organisations, and the NHS Digital page itself returned 403 to automated reading on the day. Simulation uses are hospital estate condition, backlog and running-cost inputs for health facility resilience and investment models. Related records: the PAHO Hospital Safety Index.
